verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents custom AI filters that automatically label, star and archive mail using plain-English scripts the user writes, which covers auto-labeling and steering. It also offers one-click identification of important emails and todos, importance-based Splits, and triggers that organize threads into todos, which covers surfacing what needs attention. Auditing is the gap: nothing shows a log or review trail of what the AI did, and the evidence is vendor marketing only. missing for 10: audit log/review of AI triage decisions, detailed docs on filter behavior and limits, independent hands-on corroboration of AI triage accuracy

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: Take control of your inbox with custom AI filters. Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.
Identify important emails & todos with a single click. Sweep away the rest.
You can define Splits based on: Importance, Built-in labels... Custom labels, Specific senders, Complex search queries
Set up triggers to draft replies when emails arrive, add comments for your team, organize threads into todos
